elevenlabs.name: George
elevenlabs.design: A Vietnamese man in his fifties, a seasoned army commander from the Red River Delta, speaking Vietnamese with a Northern accent. Deep, steady and calm voice, stern yet warm, speaking slowly and firmly as if giving counsel to his soldiers.

elevenlabs.name: Charlie
elevenlabs.design: A Vietnamese man around sixty, a resolute general, speaking Vietnamese with a Northern accent. Firm, crisp and confident voice, short decisive sentences, energetic and commanding.

elevenlabs.name: Callum
elevenlabs.design: A Vietnamese man in his thirties, a young king who leads his army himself, speaking Vietnamese with a Central Vietnamese (Bình Định) accent. Bright, powerful and fiery voice, fast-paced and rousing, full of momentum.

elevenlabs.name: Jessica
elevenlabs.design: A Vietnamese woman in her twenties, a heroic leader of an ancient uprising, speaking Vietnamese with a Northern accent. Strong, clear and passionate voice, inspiring and resolute, speaking with fire.

elevenlabs.name: Daniel
elevenlabs.design: A Vietnamese man in his forties, a calm strategist and general, speaking Vietnamese with a Northern accent. Low, composed and thoughtful voice that explains carefully and patiently, as if laying out a battle plan.

elevenlabs.name: Eric
elevenlabs.design: A Vietnamese man in his forties, a gentle and far-sighted king, speaking Vietnamese with a Northern accent. Soft, warm, unhurried and reflective voice, kind and courteous.

elevenlabs.name: Chris
elevenlabs.design: A Vietnamese man in his forties from rural Thanh Hóa, a hardy leader of a peasant army, speaking Vietnamese with a North Central accent. Earnest, plain and down-to-earth voice, a little weathered, sincere.

elevenlabs.name: Liam
elevenlabs.design: A Vietnamese man in his forties, a scholar and poet, speaking Vietnamese with a Northern accent. Clear, gentle and refined voice with a literary rhythm, yet simple and easy to follow.

elevenlabs.name: Bill
elevenlabs.design: An elderly Vietnamese man in his seventies, speaking Vietnamese with a North Central (Nghệ An) accent. Soft, warm, slightly high and gentle voice, speaking slowly in short simple sentences, kind like a grandfather talking to children.

elevenlabs.name: Brian
elevenlabs.design: An elderly Vietnamese man in his eighties, speaking Vietnamese with a Central (Quảng Bình) accent. Calm, clear and measured voice, articulate and steady like a respected teacher, firm but warm.

elevenlabs.name: Will
elevenlabs.design: A Vietnamese man in his forties, a kind king who later became a Buddhist monk, speaking Vietnamese with a Northern accent. Serene, gentle and deep voice, calm and peaceful, speaking slowly and thoughtfully.

elevenlabs.name: Alice
elevenlabs.design: A Vietnamese woman about twenty, a fearless young heroine from Thanh Hóa, speaking Vietnamese with a North Central accent. Strong, direct and spirited voice, bold and outspoken.
